data.description:
## Testing Mode: RED with integration exemption

Comprehensive E2E shell test for story 7034 DD9: simulate /dso:commit scenario with 3 cycles + STABLE_HALT + arbiter dispatch + BLOCK → assert pre-commit gate blocks with arbiter rationale shown.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD9: E2E shell test for the full local convergence flow.

## TDD Exemption

Citing integration exemption (TDD rubric criterion 1, integration surface): the behavioral boundaries are fully covered by unit-test RED tasks T1, T3, T5, T7 (each covers an integration boundary with mocked dependencies). This E2E test exercises COMPOSITION across all of them with real subprocess invocations and a real temp-directory artifacts dir. Written after all GREEN tasks complete because composite scenarios require all integration points wired.

## Test scenarios (one shell test function each)

1. `test_e2e_three_cycles_then_arbiter_block` — fixture diff with critical finding; mock /dso:review responses to return same finding on cycles 1, 2 (creating STABLE_HALT condition); cycle 3 hits Jaccard ≥ 0.85 → DISPATCH_ARBITER; mock arbiter response with `ruling=BLOCK, rationale="critical bug requires fix"`. Assert:
   - review-workflow.sh exits 1
   - $ARTIFACTS_DIR/cycle-ledger.json has 3 entries with matching commit_sha and identical findings
   - $ARTIFACTS_DIR/arbiter-rulings.json present with BLOCK ruling
   - Subsequently invoking pre-commit-review-gate.sh exits 1 AND stderr contains "critical bug requires fix"
2. `test_e2e_pass_branch_cycle_1` — fixture diff with no findings; cycle 1 review returns 0 findings → PASS branch. Assert review-workflow.sh exits 0; ledger has 1 entry; no arbiter sidecar written; pre-commit gate exits 0.
3. `test_e2e_short_circuit_on_rerun_same_sha` — pre-seed ledger with 1 entry for HEAD commit_sha; pre-seed arbiter-rulings.json with prior BLOCK. Run review-workflow.sh; assert exit 1; assert reviewer was NOT invoked (no /dso:review calls).
4. `test_e2e_max_cycles_arbiter` — 4 cycles all with DIFFERENT findings (Jaccard < 0.85); cycle 4 hits max_cycles → DISPATCH_ARBITER. Mock arbiter returns DROP+DEFER only (no BLOCK). Assert exit 0; orphan ticket created with `Scope: branch:<branch>`.
5. `test_e2e_drop_writes_tracker_only` — arbiter returns 1 DROP ruling. Assert `review-defense-store.sh write` invoked (check via mock invocation log); assert `review-github-defense-store.sh` NEVER invoked (no PR).

## Test framework
Use the existing bash test pattern. Each test sets up a temp `WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR`, creates fixture inputs, intercepts subprocess calls via shim scripts on PATH (or via DSO_TEST_HOOK env var if supported), runs review-workflow.sh, asserts post-conditions.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] 5 E2E test functions defined
  Verify: grep -cE '^test_e2e_' tests/scripts/test-local-review-workflow-e2e.sh   # expect 5
- [ ] All 5 E2E tests pass (after all GREEN tasks complete)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-local-review-workflow-e2e.sh
- [ ] Test does NOT make real LLM calls (verified by reviewing the mock surface)
  Verify: grep -c 'mock\|fixture\|stub' tests/scripts/test-local-review-workflow-e2e.sh   # expect ≥ 5
- [ ] Test file is executable + registered
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-local-review-workflow-e2e.sh && grep 'test-local-review-workflow-e2e.sh' .test-index
- [ ] shellcheck passes
  Verify: shellcheck tests/scripts/test-local-review-workflow-e2e.sh

## File Impact
- tests/scripts/test-local-review-workflow-e2e.sh (new, ~400 lines)
- .test-index (append registration)
